outcomeSemantics.description: The declared meaning of each outcome for THIS verifier (EV1.0: a verifier declares pass/fail/unknown semantics). All three declarations are mandatory non-empty text.

description: The outcome semantics object: the declared meaning of pass, fail and unknown for a specific verifier (EV1.0: "A verifier declares required evidence, method, pass/fail/unknown semantics and reproducibility policy"). The outcome vocabulary itself is the closed enum pass | fail | unknown — it has no quantitative members and cannot carry graded values (architecture-lock rule 7).
title: Arena verification-outcome v1
